# INSIGNIA

> INSIGNIA (also known as Insignia Tech) is a software company in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. It builds business software for Indian traders, distributors and manufacturers: ERP products, AI automation and digital marketing.

## Contact

- Website: https://www.insigniatech.in
- Email: Insignia0026@gmail.com

- Address: Orchid-407, Manglam Ananda, Sanganer, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302029, India
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Products

- [TradeFlow ERP](https://www.insigniatech.in/tradeflow): Cloud ERP for traders, wholesalers and distributors in India. Sales, purchases, multi-location inventory, customer and supplier records, warehouse management and business reports in one system.
- [TransformerFlow](https://www.insigniatech.in/transformerflow): ERP for manufacturing. Production management, bill of materials, raw material management, production planning, quality control, costing and machinery rental tracking.
- [Order Sathi](https://www.insigniatech.in/order-sathi): Order and inventory management for online sellers. Multi-channel order management, packing and dispatch, barcode scanning and merchant tax report reconciliation. Amazon orders sync today; other channels are on the roadmap.

TradeFlow ERP by INSIGNIA (Jaipur, India) is not related to any other company named Tradeflow or TradeflowAI.
